'''Geezum''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] paid very well by<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Geezum}}</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to explore new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and chart difficult terrain. He was unsure of Jabba's motivations for his work.<ref name="CCG" /> Geezum was a [[Psychopathy|sociopath]]<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> with [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, black-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="rotj" />

Like all Snivvians, he would sometimes be nicknamed "Snaggletooth" by other species.

==Behind the scenes==
Geezum's appearance in ''Return of the Jedi'' places Snivvians, alongside [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], among the only two alien species in all three films of the original trilogy.

Geezum was portrayed by [[Peter Allen]].
